tag: Furhat Robotics · Computer Vision · Conversational AI
title: Real-Time Social Interaction with Furhat
description: A lightweight Python toolkit for natural multimodal interaction with Furhat social robots, synchronizing computer vision (facial mesh, 3D pose, gaze estimation), speech acoustics, and local language models (Llama 3.2 via Ollama) with sub-second response times for clinical and interactive settings.

media.alt: Real-Time Social Interaction with Furhat robot featuring multimodal perception and facial mesh tracking

title: ADOS-2 Multimodal Behavior Analysis Framework
description: An end-to-end clinical AI framework designed to support clinicians during standardized ADOS-2 diagnostic evaluations by automatically analyzing child-clinician interactions. Integrates 3D body and hand pose tracking, object manipulation detection, acoustic speech processing, and smart glasses for gaze and blink dynamics, combining deep learning representations with rule-based models to objectively detect verbal and non-verbal communicative requests.

media.alt: ADOS-2 Multimodal Behavior Analysis Framework child-clinician evaluation pipeline

tag: DeepRehab · 2D Human Pose Estimation · Edge TPU · Physical Therapy
title: DeepRehab: 2D Human Pose Estimation on the Edge
description: A real-time edge AI system for home-based knee injury telerehabilitation, enabling patients to perform physical therapy exercises with automated joint tracking and biofeedback. Implements a modified PersonLab architecture predicting heatmaps and offsets for 23 anatomical keypoints (17 body + 6 feet), optimized for Google Coral Edge TPU at 20 FPS with temporal filtering to reduce knee angle RMSE by 10.7%.

media.alt: DeepRehab multi-person pose estimation and knee joint angle tracking demonstration

tag: Computer Vision · CNNs · Eye Gaze Tracking
title: Eye Gaze Direction Recognition using Convolutional Neural Networks on Low-Resolution Cameras
description: A deep learning framework answering how to effectively recognize eye gaze direction by maximizing performance while reducing hardware costs. Developed ESGDset (156,000 images under diverse illumination, head postures, and scenarios) and GDNet, a two-phase architecture that segments candidate eye regions before classification, achieving 98.32% accuracy with an error rate of 0.087 on low-resolution cameras.

media.alt: Eye Gaze Direction Recognition candidate eye segmentation and gaze classification architecture

tag: Computer Vision · MobileNet · ResNet · TFLite · Android App
title: NakedFood: AI Mobile App for Automated Food Ingredient Recognition
description: An end-to-end Android mobile computer vision app helping users with food allergies, medical conditions, or dietary restrictions avoid harmful ingredients. Powered by MobileNet (101 food classes) and ResNet converted to TensorFlow Lite for real-time camera inference and instant ingredient lookup.

media.alt: NakedFood Android mobile app animated demonstration predicting food items and displaying ingredient breakdown

title: Kriol NLP & Computational Linguistics Toolkit
description: An open-source initiative developing natural language processing toolkits, translation benchmarks, and acoustic speech datasets for Cape Verdean Creole (Kriolu) to promote cultural preservation and linguistic equity in modern language models.
